description: Nominal published costs and budgets for diagnostic comparisons. Stated year is not proof of commissioning or cost-year verification. No inflation adjustment is applied without an appropriate published index. Unknown publication dates/scopes and realised costs remain unverified; point count never raises confidence automatically.

benchmarks.source: Agripower issuer release 2025-10-30: 136 Nm3/h, EUR5.4m planned phase-one total investment; EPC works contract EUR3.3m. Commissioning expected end-2026; not a realised construction cost.

Agripower issuer release 2026-04-13: 106 Nm3/h, 10900 t/year agricultural inputs, EUR5.5m planned investment, construction contract being finalised; commissioning targeted before end-2027. Same developer as Sarthe; not an independent as-built validation.
